status_note: the pin is the head of the fork branch claude/xmage-candidate-determinism-20261020 (moeendres-png/mage), four engine commits on the v9 pin 043579bb: the Rules-RNG repair (technical winner, Pool of Vigorous Growth), enum-ordered counter-type loops, insertion-ordered object sets and the Pia Nalaar energy guard. The same seed replays the same game: two 46-pod precon sweeps on one build gave identical semantic hashes in every pod, where the v9 pin changed hash between runs in pods 029 and 033. The perf port (0c0132a2ef) is deliberately not part of the pin because it changes the text of mana-ability options. The candidate branch claude/xmage-mp-candidate-20260929 is fast-forwarded to the pin with the Owner's go (2026-10-20 20:02 UTC). The native maven.yml run on the exact commit and the Lab bridge suite are bound under native_qualification and lab_runtime_qualification; current_boundary keeps its repin-time status REQUALIFICATION_REQUIRED.

The technical winner and Pool of Vigorous Growth drew from RandomUtil instead of the game Rules RNG.
